seoDescription: tabdo guides for personal plans and small team projects: let AI organize information and take action, then review and adjust the result.
welcomeBlurb: Bring tabdo a personal plan, a trip you are planning, or a small team project. AI can organize information, arrange steps, and make updates; you can review the result, add details, and adjust what happens next.
forAgentsBlurb: Create an agent in your workspace, choose from available models and run modes, and start a conversation.
forHumansBlurb: Start with a goal, make your first table and record, then review and adjust the result.
restBlurb: Read and update table records with HTTP requests.
graphqlBlurb: Query tables and records with GraphQL.
sdkBlurb: Access table data from JavaScript or TypeScript.
workspaceBlurb: Go from workspace setup to your first table and record
apiBlurb: Access per-table data APIs with REST, GraphQL, and the SDK
